```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

find_repo_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  current <- normalizePath(start, mustWork = TRUE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(current, "TransferSemi", "DESCRIPTION")) &&
        dir.exists(file.path(current, "visualization_github"))) return(current)
    parent <- dirname(current)
    if (identical(parent, current)) break
    current <- parent
  }
  stop("Cannot locate the repository root.", call. = FALSE)
}

repo_root <- find_repo_root()
result_dir <- file.path(
  repo_root, "semi-transfer-learning", "results_finetune_new8"
)
time_dir <- file.path(
  repo_root, "semi-transfer-learning", "results_finetune_new_time8"
)
derived_dir <- file.path(
  repo_root, "outputs", "derived", "finetune_available_visualization"
)
figure_dir <- file.path(
  repo_root, "outputs", "figures", "finetune_available_visualization"
)
dir.create(derived_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
# This notebook keeps its plots in the rendered HTML and therefore does not
# create an empty standalone-figure directory.

library(ggplot2)
```

## Fine-tuning MSE across seeds

```{r mse}
mse_files <- list.files(
  result_dir,
  pattern = "^mse_data_seed_[0-9]+[.]rds$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)
if (length(mse_files) == 0L) {
  stop("No fine-tuning MSE files were found in ", result_dir, call. = FALSE)
}

read_mse <- function(path) {
  value <- readRDS(path)
  task_columns <- grep("^Task[0-9]+$", names(value), value = TRUE)
  if (length(task_columns) == 0L) {
    stop("No task columns found in ", path, call. = FALSE)
  }

  setting <- basename(dirname(path))
  matched <- regexec("^mse_n_([0-9]+)_simi_(.+)$", setting)
  parts <- regmatches(setting, matched)[[1]]
  if (length(parts) != 3L) stop("Unrecognized setting directory: ", setting)

  data.frame(
    seed = as.integer(sub("^mse_data_seed_([0-9]+)[.]rds$", "\\1", basename(path))),
    n = as.integer(parts[[2]]),
    similarity = as.numeric(parts[[3]]),
    method = if (is.null(rownames(value))) {
      "Global fine-tuned late fusion with nuisance"
    } else {
      rownames(value)[[1]]
    },
    mean_mse = mean(as.numeric(value[1, task_columns]), na.rm = TRUE),
    maximum_mse = max(as.numeric(value[1, task_columns]), na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

mse_results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(mse_files, read_mse))
mse_results$method[mse_results$method == "NonPara_Transfer_Tuned"] <-
  "Global fine-tuned late fusion with nuisance"
mse_results <- mse_results[order(
  mse_results$n, mse_results$similarity, mse_results$seed
), ]
write.csv(
  mse_results,
  file.path(derived_dir, "fine_tuning_mse_by_seed.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

mean_plot <- ggplot(
  mse_results,
  aes(x = factor(similarity), y = mean_mse, fill = method)
) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, coef = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~n, scales = "free_y", labeller = label_both) +
  labs(x = "Similarity", y = "Mean task MSE", fill = "Method") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
# Not saved: this plot is retained in the HTML only.
# ggsave(
#   file.path(figure_dir, "fine_tuning_mean_mse.pdf"),
#   mean_plot,
#   width = 12,
#   height = 6
# )
mean_plot

maximum_plot <- ggplot(
  mse_results,
  aes(x = factor(similarity), y = maximum_mse, fill = method)
) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, coef = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~n, scales = "free_y", labeller = label_both) +
  labs(x = "Similarity", y = "Maximum task MSE", fill = "Method") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
# Not saved: this plot is retained in the HTML only.
# ggsave(
#   file.path(figure_dir, "fine_tuning_maximum_mse.pdf"),
#   maximum_plot,
#   width = 12,
#   height = 6
# )
maximum_plot
```

## Fine-tuning runtime across seeds

```{r runtime}
time_files <- list.files(
  time_dir,
  pattern = "^time_seed_[0-9]+[.]csv$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)
if (length(time_files) == 0L) {
  stop("No fine-tuning runtime files were found in ", time_dir, call. = FALSE)
}

runtime_results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(time_files, function(path) {
  value <- read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  required <- c("seed", "n", "similarity", "dim", "runtime_sec")
  missing <- setdiff(required, names(value))
  if (length(missing)) {
    stop("Missing runtime columns in ", path, ": ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  }
  value[, required, drop = FALSE]
}))
runtime_results$runtime_minutes <- runtime_results$runtime_sec / 60
runtime_results <- runtime_results[order(
  runtime_results$n, runtime_results$similarity, runtime_results$seed
), ]
write.csv(
  runtime_results,
  file.path(derived_dir, "fine_tuning_runtime_by_seed.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

runtime_plot <- ggplot(
  runtime_results,
  aes(x = factor(similarity), y = runtime_minutes)
) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, coef = 2, fill = "steelblue") +
  facet_wrap(~n, scales = "free_y", labeller = label_both) +
  labs(x = "Similarity", y = "Runtime (minutes)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
# Not saved: this plot is retained in the HTML only.
# ggsave(
#   file.path(figure_dir, "fine_tuning_runtime.pdf"),
#   runtime_plot,
#   width = 12,
#   height = 6
# )
runtime_plot
```
